settings.heading: Blooming in the North
settings.subheading: Designed in Norway. Inspired by the beauty of the North.

settings.heading: BLÓMINOR
settings.text: The name BLÓMINOR comes from the idea of blooming in the North. It brings together blóm, the Old Norse word for flower, with the Norwegian words i nord, meaning 'in the North.' The name reflects the wildflowers that bloom between stone, forest and fjord, bringing colour to the northern landscape through the changing seasons.

settings.quote: Jewellery can be a gift to yourself — chosen simply because it brings you joy.

settings.title: Hverdagsglede
settings.content: The Norwegian feeling of finding joy in the little things that make an ordinary day feel special. Jewellery does not have to be saved only for rare occasions or important milestones. It can be worn simply because it brings happiness to an ordinary day.

settings.title: Inspired by Scandinavia
settings.content: From the soft colours of long summer evenings to the cooler light reflected across snow, water and winter skies. Shades of fjord blue, lavender, soft pink, forest green and silver flow through the designs, creating a world shaped by Nordic nature, light and colour.
